content.comment_body: I'm unable to display decimal values on the vertical axis in the Trend view. It seems that newer versions of [product_name] have this issue and may need an update to fix it.
How is this related to the topic title?
It’s just another missing feature alongside the slowdown mentioned in the topic. Is it not allowed to share my opinion?
You’re welcome to share your thoughts. However, it’s better to post comments relevant to the topic or create a new one for unrelated issues.
No worries, a moderator like [user_name] might move or split this into a new post, though that may not be necessary since this is more of an opinion than a direct question.
There’s no point in going into detail. To clarify: Are you suggesting that it's the moderator’s responsibility to split your posts? That’s what moderation is for?
Moderators have the authority to review and make decisions about posts. You're not a moderator, so you can't enforce rules here.
